description: Presidential Secretariat - Members of the Presidential Task Force on Sri Lanka's Education Affairs
categorisation: This gazette contains ONLY government personnel changes (appointments to a Task Force) with named individuals and their basic titles/positions. It does NOT include detailed descriptions of portfolio responsibilities or subject matter areas for these individuals, which would be required for a Hybrid (Type 3) classification. The content focuses solely on who is being appointed to the Task Force, making it a People Gazette.
